title: TopologyRelationshipIntent
description: Request payload for compiling a callable topology relationship through the overlays:compile endpoint. The caller selects a relationship id and provides optional source and qualifier hints; topology-service owns validation, graph binding, and rendering.

relationshipId.description: Stable topology relationship id selected from scoped relationship availability.

renderMode.description: Requested render mode. topology-service validates it against relationship availability.

qualifiers.description: Typed relationship qualifiers such as vlanId, vrf, protocol, siteId, or cloudAccountId.

label.description: Optional short layer label requested by the caller.
